name: apprenti.dev Performance Engineering
audience: Experienced engineers specializing into performance engineering: measurement, profiling, benchmarking, evidenced caching, load testing, and capacity reasoning
philosophy: Measure first. Every number in this path comes from a run the apprentice can repeat, not from a guess. LEARN BY DOING. GROW THROUGH MENTORSHIP.
aiPrinciples: AI assistance must be disclosed when materially used.
Tasks may restrict solution generation while allowing explanations, hints and quizzes.
The apprentice remains accountable for every submitted number, profile, plan and capacity claim.
Mentor approval is based on demonstrated measurement and diagnosis, not on a claimed speedup.
